newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chase HK branch to set HK$1.5 bln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Chase HK branch to set HK$1.5 bln FRCD.

text.p: The lead manager and market maker group has formed for Chase Manhattan Bank Hong Kong branch's HK$1.5 billion floating rate certificates of deposit issue, the sole arranger and bookrunner Chase Manhattan Asia said Thursday.

The three-year certificates will pay a coupon of 27.5 basis points over the one-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate. Application has been made to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority to accept the issue as eligible for its Liquidity Adjustment Facility, or discount window.
Lead managers and market makers are Chase Manhattan Asia, HSBC Markets, Sakura Finance Asia, Schroders Asia and Union Bank of Switzerland.
The issue will be launched into general syndication later on Thursday.
